clientScopes.name: tenant
clientScopes.description: Maps the tenant_id user attribute onto issued tokens — the claim backend-common's Keycloak auth middleware trusts for RLS scoping (see packages/backend-common/src/keycloak-auth.ts).

clients.name: Dev/test token minting (curl) — NOT the real mobile client
clients.description: Public client, Direct Access Grants only, for curl-minted dev tokens. Phase 3's real mobile client uses PKCE instead.

clients.name: Metrock mobile app (Phase 3 - real PKCE client)
clients.description: The real mobile client, Authorization Code + PKCE via system browser. Never Direct Access Grants.

clients.name: procurement-service (machine-to-machine, client-credentials grant)
clients.description: Real M2M auth for PostingAuthorityClient's calls to governance-service's /authorization-check and /approval-check (docs/RUNBOOK.md) — replaces the old plain x-tenant-id header stub. Client id doubles as the token's azp claim, which governance-service checks against its caller allow-list.
